title: The 3 Day: Reading Monday's Manga & Anime News Through the Number of Expression
content:
Today's Number: 3

On Monday, July 13, 2026, the day's headlines arrive under the sign of the 3 — the numerologist's number of expression, a vibration of communication, creativity, and the public stage. It is a useful lens, if only a literary one, for reading a news cycle led this morning by "Doctor Doom Seizes Captain America's Soul, Drags Him To Hell in New Comic." Strip away the mysticism and the number still works as a mood: the stories crossing the wire share a common temperature, and today that temperature reads as expression.

Set "Doctor Doom Seizes Captain America's Soul, Drags Him To Hell in New Comic" beside "Rick and Morty S09E08: Rick Steals Morty's Empathy, Darker Future Ahead" and a thread begins to show. The two stories come from different desks — perhaps different corners of the industry — yet both turn on the same underlying tension that the 3 tends to surface: the pull between what is being started and what is being held together. Read together rather than apart, the day's lead items stop looking like isolated announcements and start looking like a single weather system.

The Connective Thread

Beneath the lead, the supporting stories — "Speedrun Spectacle: SGDQ Raises $2.4 Million for Doctors Without Borders", "Mayfair Witches Season 3 Teaser Drops, But Fans Face Shocking 2027 Wait", "Nightwing on the Brink: Bludhaven's Architect Forces Dick Grayson to the Edge", "President Curtis Spinoff Rewrites Its Lead, Kicks Off with One-Shot Rick and Morty Cameo" — fill in the pattern. Coverage from Bleeding Cool keeps circling the same themes: franchises under strain, decisions deferred, and the quiet recalculation of who holds the initiative. None of these stories was written with the others in mind, which is precisely why their convergence is worth noting. The job of analysis is to read the cycle as a whole, and the whole, today, leans hard into expression.

Catzye scanned 40 headlines across the major manga and anime feeds today. Of those, 4 carry titles that reduce, letter by letter, to today's number 3. That is a coincidence of language rather than fate — but it is the kind of coincidence that makes you look twice, and looking twice is the whole point of reading the news slowly.

Among those number-3 headlines: "Digger Trailer Drops Amid Buzz: Is Tom Cruise Hiding a Major Transformation?"; "Portlandia Creators Armisen, Brownstein Reunite for Rewatch Podcast"; "Matthew Mercer Lends Voice to Warframe's Gritty Sci-Fi Noir Expansion, Tau"; "VFX Legends Ishiro Honda, Tomoyuki Tanaka Inducted Into VES Hall of Fame". Whatever you make of the arithmetic, the stories themselves reward attention. Each one, in its way, is a story about communication, creativity, and the public stage — which is to say, a story about the choices facing the people in it.

What To Watch

If the 3 is the number of expression, then the test of the next few days is whether today's openings are followed through or quietly abandoned. Numerology would call that the difference between the number's higher and lower expression. A journalist would just call it the follow-up — the second-day story that tells you whether the first one mattered. Either way, the questions are the same: who acts, who waits, and who pays for the delay.

Catzye's daily analysis reads the news through the lens of the day's number. It is not a forecast. It is a way of paying attention — a reminder that the headlines, however scattered, tend to rhyme. Check back tomorrow, when the number turns over and the pattern shifts with it.

A Note on Method

Every headline on this page was pulled from our newsroom feeds and reduced using standard Pythagorean numerology — each letter mapped to a digit one through nine, summed by word, then reduced until a single digit or master number remains. The same arithmetic that gives a name its Destiny number gives a headline its vibration. We make no claim that the universe arranges the news to suit a number. We claim only that a constraint, even an arbitrary one, is a good way to force fresh attention onto stories you might otherwise scroll past — and that the day's events, read together, almost always tell a more coherent story than any one of them does alone.

title: Doctor Doom Seizes Captain America's Soul, Drags Him To Hell in New Comic
content:
Well, this is one way to kick off an issue. Victor Von Doom is dragging Captain America's soul straight to Hell in the upcoming Captain America #13. It's a wild premise, even for comics, and definitely not your average Tuesday for Steve Rogers. Doom has sinister plans, aiming to weaponize the Sentinel of Liberty in an 'unfamiliar battlefield' deep within the inferno.

Writer Chip Zdarsky and artist Ton Lima continue their epic run, throwing Cap into his most dire situation yet. As Steve fights for survival in this demonic landscape, the world he left behind teeters on the brink, with the 'ARMAGEDDON' event looming large. Fans of high-stakes supernatural drama and classic Marvel rivalries won't want to miss this.
excerpt: Doctor Doom has captured Captain America's soul, dragging him to Hell in the explosive Captain America #13. This new issue sees Steve Rogers as an unwilling weapon in a demonic battlefield, as writer Chip Zdarsky and artist Ton Lima push Cap to his limits amid the looming 'ARMAGEDDON' event.
imageAlt: Cover of Captain America #13 depicting Captain America's soul in a fiery, demonic landscape with Doctor Doom nearby.
pullQuote: Victor Von Doom is dragging Captain America's soul straight to Hell in the upcoming Captain America #13.
editorNote: This kind of high-concept, character-driven peril is exactly what makes comics so compelling. Zdarsky and Lima are clearly pulling no punches, promising a truly hellish journey for Cap. It'll be interesting to see how this ties into the broader 'ARMAGEDDON' event.

title: Rick and Morty S09E08: Rick Steals Morty's Empathy, Darker Future Ahead
content:
Rick and Morty just delivered a gut punch to fans. Season 9, Episode 8, "Rickuiem Mort a Dream," saw Rick unleash a new level of emotional abuse, ultimately stripping Morty of his empathy. This isn't just a bad day for Morty; it's a chilling escalation in their toxic dynamic.

Rick called Morty a burden, then twisted his brain to remove any emotional impact from further insults. That's a dark turn, even for Rick Sanchez. The episode didn't pull its punches. Morty's internal struggle was brilliantly animated, culminating in Rick literally tearing a creature — Morty's empathy — from his ear. What followed was a disturbing mirror effect: an uncaring Morty, leaving Rick uncomfortable with his own reflection. This echoes fan fears about a new "Evil Morty" emerging, or perhaps the return of the original.

Meanwhile, the B-plot offered bizarre contrasts. Jerry, once a pathetic punching bag, surprised everyone by bravely confronting a serial killer. Summer, however, took a darker path, showing chillingly pragmatic, almost sociopathic, traits reminiscent of Rick himself. The animation team deserves praise for the episode's visual inventiveness, particularly the reality-bending sequences.

Looking ahead, Adult Swim has big plans for San Diego Comic-Con. Fans can look forward to a panel for Rick and Morty Season 9, featuring the full voice cast and executive producers Dan Harmon and Scott Marder. The event will also host a premiere panel for "President Curtis," a new animated comedy from the Rick and Morty universe, co-created by Harmon and James Siciliano, and starring Keith David. It's clear the multiverse is expanding, but the true cost to its characters remains unsettling.
excerpt: Rick and Morty's latest episode, "Rickuiem Mort a Dream," delivered a shocking blow as Rick deliberately stripped Morty of his empathy. This disturbing act has fans speculating about the emergence of a new "Evil Morty" or the return of a familiar threat. The episode also saw Summer embracing Rick's darker traits, while Jerry showed unexpected bravery.
imageAlt: Rick and Morty standing in a brightly lit, fantastical alien landscape, looking distressed
pullQuote: Rick called Morty a burden, then twisted his brain to remove any emotional impact from further insults. That's a dark turn, even for Rick Sanchez.
editorNote: This episode is a true game-changer, pushing Rick and Morty's relationship into uncharted, disturbing territory. Fans will be dissecting Morty's empathy loss for weeks, and the parallels to 'Evil Morty' are undeniable. What's interesting is how quickly the show is evolving other characters like Summer and Jerry.

title: Speedrun Spectacle: SGDQ Raises $2.4 Million for Doctors Without Borders
content:
Speedrunning fans just witnessed another incredible feat: Summer Games Done Quick officially wrapped, not only showcasing mind-bending gameplay but also raising a massive $2.4 million for Doctors Without Borders. It's a testament to the gaming community's power to do good.

The week-long marathon was packed with unforgettable moments. Bluekandy's world-record-shattering run of Kirby Air Riders left audiences breathless. The chaotic, laugh-out-loud Hey You, Pikachu! segment and a truly improbable Balatro triumph also stood out. Even the Resident Evil: Requiem run featured spontaneous beatboxing – because why not? These are the zany, unexpected highlights fans crave.

Beyond the speedruns, SGDQ fostered community with panels, board game rooms, and a bustling vendor's alley. Every cent raised, from donations to merchandise, directly benefits Doctors Without Borders (Médecins Sans Frontières), providing life-saving medical care worldwide. The charity even highlighted its critical work in Gaza through a powerful documentary during the event.

Games Done Quick has been orchestrating these epic charity marathons for 15 years, bringing together top speedrunners and raising over $60 million for various causes. This year's SGDQ proved again that the gaming community's generosity and skill know no bounds.
excerpt: Summer Games Done Quick just concluded an electrifying week of speedrunning, raising an impressive $2.4 million for Doctors Without Borders. Highlights included a world-record Kirby Air Riders run and spontaneous beatboxing, showcasing the gaming community's incredible skill and generosity for a vital cause.
imageAlt: A speedrunner plays a video game on stage at Summer Games Done Quick, with an audience and charity tracker in the background.
pullQuote: This year's SGDQ proved again that the gaming community's generosity and skill know no bounds.
editorNote: This annual event consistently showcases the best of gaming while doing immense good. It's a powerful reminder of the gaming community's ability to unite for critical causes, and fans should keep an eye on how these impressive funds impact global health efforts.

title: Mayfair Witches Season 3 Teaser Drops, But Fans Face Shocking 2027 Wait
content:
Fans of Anne Rice’s Mayfair Witches just got a tantalizing new teaser for Season 3, but prepare for a shock: the supernatural drama won’t return until 2027. That’s a three-year wait for more Alexandra Daddario-led witchy mayhem in AMC’s ambitious Anne Rice Immortal Universe.

The brief Season 3 teaser debuted during an episode of The Vampire Lestat, hinting at a cross-series connection. The clip promised “more power, more problems,” a classic trope for a show steeped in family curses and dark magic.

This new season brings some exciting talent to the coven. Michiel Huisman (Game of Thrones) joins as Michael, a carpenter whose dark past unravels when he falls for Rowan Mayfair. Betsy Brandt (Breaking Bad), James Frain, and Eliza Scanlen also join the ensemble cast, though their roles are still under wraps.

Thomas Schnauz, a veteran writer and producer from Breaking Bad and Better Call Saul, steps in as co-showrunner alongside Esta Spalding. His pedigree is a huge plus for the series. Schnauz recently confirmed that filming for Season 3 has wrapped, making the 2027 release date even more perplexing for a show already in the can.

The upcoming season promises to dive deeper into witchcraft mythology. Expect new “spellbound” families and a journey to the infamous town of Salem, a fitting backdrop for the Mayfair family’s expanding secrets. This move aligns with AMC’s larger vision to build out the Anne Rice Immortal Universe, weaving together its various supernatural sagas.
excerpt: A new teaser for Anne Rice’s Mayfair Witches Season 3 has dropped, revealing a surprising 2027 return date for the Alexandra Daddario-led supernatural drama. The upcoming season, co-showrun by Breaking Bad veteran Thomas Schnauz, promises more magic, new cast members, and a deep dive into Salem's witchy history.
imageAlt: Alexandra Daddario as Rowan Mayfair with glowing eyes and magical energy, against a gothic or supernatural background
pullQuote: The supernatural drama won’t return until 2027. That’s a three-year wait for more Alexandra Daddario-led witchy mayhem.
editorNote: A three-year gap between seasons, especially after filming has wrapped, is an eternity in today's streaming landscape. This could significantly test fan patience, even for a show with a strong lead like Daddario. What's interesting here is AMC's commitment to building the 'Anne Rice Immortal Universe' — a long-term strategy that might explain such an extended wait, perhaps to align with other series releases. Fans will want to watch how this affects momentum.

title: Nightwing on the Brink: Bludhaven's Architect Forces Dick Grayson to the Edge
content:
Dick Grayson is at a breaking point in Bludhaven. The city's protector, usually known for his agility and bright spirit, is plunged into its grimiest corners. Nightwing is hunting a killer, "Cannibal Colm," a trail leading through the city's dive bars. But this isn't just a street-level pursuit. The investigation connects directly to the "super-villainous architect" behind Bludhaven's twisted superhighway system.

Writer Dan Watters and artist Denys Cowan are taking Nightwing deep into the city's corrupt infrastructure. Bludhaven has always reflected a rotten core, but this story finds a fresh angle by giving it a specific, sinister designer. Nightwing's hunt isn't solely about justice; it's about confronting how the city itself shapes its inhabitants and their crimes. Previews show Dick grappling with the dark realities, risking a moral line he's always staunchly avoided. For a hero famed for his optimism, seeing him tested this intensely is always a significant draw for fans. This issue promises a compelling blend of gritty detective work and profound personal stakes.
excerpt: Nightwing #140 pushes Dick Grayson to his limits as he hunts a killer through Bludhaven's grim dive bars. The investigation uncovers a deeper conspiracy, connecting to the "super-villainous architect" who designed the city's corrupt highway system. This new arc by Dan Watters and Denys Cowan promises high stakes and a moral crisis for the hero.
imageAlt: Nightwing, in his black and blue costume, standing in a dimly lit dive bar, looking intense.
pullQuote: For a hero famed for his optimism, seeing him tested this intensely is always a significant draw for fans.
editorNote: This arc sounds like a fascinating exploration of Nightwing's character, pushing him into truly dark territory. Fans who appreciate Batman-style detective work but with a more personal, emotional core will want to pick this up. We're eager to see how Dan Watters develops Bludhaven's systemic corruption.

title: President Curtis Spinoff Rewrites Its Lead, Kicks Off with One-Shot Rick and Morty Cameo
content:
Hold onto your portal guns, Rick and Morty fans, because the upcoming President Curtis spinoff is making some bold moves. Creators Dan Harmon and James Siciliano have fundamentally reshaped the character for his solo series, moving him from an approval-seeking side character to a "golden retriever" type who begrudgingly takes on the world's most thankless job. The biggest twist? Rick and Morty themselves will appear in the spinoff's premiere episode, but don't expect them to stick around.

This highly anticipated spinoff, "President Curtis," hits screens July 26th. It stars Keith David as the titular President Andre Curtis, alongside Stephanie Beatriz and Jim Rash, tackling interdimensional diplomacy and paranormal crises that Rick Sanchez simply can't be bothered with. Harmon frames it as a "concentric circle" to Rick and Morty, allowing similar tonality without redundant overlap, like an X-Files to Doctor Who's alien-hunting.

Harmon and Siciliano revealed their vision for President Curtis in a recent interview. The original Rick and Morty version craved approval. The spinoff President? He's the opposite. This President would never lie or cheat for higher numbers; he's doing the job because if he doesn't, someone worse will. He's a soldier, a vampire slayer, and surprisingly, a "lonely guy" who took the job out of duty, not ambition. This is a significant deepening of a fan-favorite character.

As for Rick and Morty's cameo, it’s a deliberate "one and done" for the season. Siciliano stated they wanted to address the "elephant in the room" of a spinoff but quickly let the new series establish its own identity and cast. This is a smart play, ensuring the spinoff can stand on its own two feet rather than being a mere extension. Meanwhile, back on the main show, Rick and Morty S09E08, "Rickuiem Mort a Dream," promises more of Rick's signature resentment issues being dumped squarely on Morty.
excerpt: The upcoming President Curtis spinoff reimagines its titular character from an approval-seeker to a duty-bound leader. Creators Dan Harmon and James Siciliano confirm Rick and Morty will make a single, deliberate cameo in the premiere before the new series carves its own independent path. This promises a fresh take on a fan-favorite character.
imageAlt: Key visual for the President Curtis spinoff, featuring President Andre Curtis standing heroically, with Rick and Morty faintly visible in the background.
pullQuote: The spinoff President would never lie or cheat for higher numbers; he’s doing the job because if he doesn't, someone worse will.
editorNote: This character overhaul for President Curtis is a bold move that could elevate the spinoff beyond mere fan service. It shows real ambition to tell a unique story within the Rick and Morty universe. Fans should definitely tune in to see how this re-imagined leader takes on cosmic threats and to catch that intriguing initial cameo.

title: Catzye Exclusive: Showrunner Teases Claudia's Explosive Return in Vampire Lestat Season 3!
content:
Prepare yourselves, Anne Rice fans. Showrunner Rolin Jones just dropped a bombshell about The Vampire Lestat Season 3's upcoming Episode 6, "Montreal." It seems we're finally getting the Claudia moment we've been waiting for.

Jones didn't hold back, calling it "The best Claudia scene we ever wrote." That's a bold claim, especially considering Delainey Hayles' character turned to ash last season, albeit with a vow to return. Hayles has been playing Regina, a diner waitress Louis has an interest in. But the tease strongly hints at a proper comeback for the fan-favorite vampire.

Jones explained his decision to give Claudia and Louis (Jacob Anderson) expanded storylines, citing his admiration for the actors. "I loved these actors, and I did not feel we had done everything we could do with Delainey," he stated. This creative choice is a welcome change for viewers, giving beloved characters more room to shine than their literary counterparts at this stage.

Season 3 itself has taken a rock-and-roll turn, following Lestat on an electric tour as he grapples with muses from his past. His rising power coincides with the "Great Conversion," a surge in the vampire population. On the casting front, Sheila Atim joins the ensemble as Akasha, the very first vampire. Episode 6, directed by Jane Wu and written by Ryan Kattner and Kevin Hanna, is set to be a pivotal episode leading into next week's finale.
excerpt: Showrunner Rolin Jones promises an unforgettable return for fan-favorite Claudia in The Vampire Lestat Season 3 Episode 6, calling it the character's "best scene ever written." This episode, leading into the season finale, will deliver on promises of deeper character exploration for both Claudia and Louis, driven by Jones' admiration for the actors.
imageAlt: Promotional image for The Vampire Lestat Season 3 Episode 6, featuring Delainey Hayles as Claudia
pullQuote: The best Claudia scene we ever wrote is in episode 6. It's not even close.
editorNote: This is a massive development for fans of the Anne Rice universe, especially those who felt Claudia's arc was cut short. What's interesting here is Jones' willingness to diverge from the books to serve the actors and the show's narrative. Fans will definitely want to clear their schedules for this one.

title: New Sentry-Level Powerhouse Explodes into Zdarsky's Avengers: Armageddon #2
content:
A powerful new hero, potentially on par with the cosmic-level Sentry, is set to debut in Marvel's upcoming Avengers: Armageddon #2. This mysterious powerhouse emerges to confront General Thunderbolt Ross's rampaging Red Hulk, a conflict teased to cause a 'major shakeup' for the Avengers.

General Ross, as Red Hulk, has a history of destructive rampages, but this new challenger promises an unprecedented threat. The official synopsis hints at a character capable of 'leveling Red Hulk and the Avengers' — no small feat. This could be a game-changer.

Written by the acclaimed Chip Zdarsky, with art by Delio Diaz and Frank Alpizar, this event series promises high stakes and lasting consequences for the Marvel Universe. The Sentry's power level designation means this new character could drastically alter the superhero landscape, perhaps even influencing future MCU narratives. Avengers: Armageddon #2 hits comic shop shelves on July 15th, 2026.
excerpt: Marvel's Avengers: Armageddon #2 introduces a mysterious new hero boasting Sentry-level power, stepping in to halt Red Hulk's global rampage. This highly anticipated issue, penned by Chip Zdarsky, promises a significant shakeup for Earth's Mightiest Heroes.
imageAlt: Cover art for Avengers: Armageddon #2 featuring Red Hulk battling a new patriotic-themed hero.

title: House of the Dragon Showrunner Hints at Westeros Exit After 'Massive' Final Season
content:
House of the Dragon's fourth and final season is shaping up to be "massive," according to showrunner Ryan Condal. In a recent interview with Deadline Hollywood, Condal revealed the ambition for the upcoming season, promising it will be "the biggest season we have made, for sure." This comes as Season 3 continues to heat up the Dance of the Dragons, with viewers deep in the brutal Targaryen civil war.

But here's the kicker: despite renewing his deal with HBO, Condal hinted he might be done with Westeros after House of the Dragon concludes. He expressed a desire to "establish the beginning of the next chapter," adding, "I think I have said what I have to say about Westeros." This is a significant shift. Many fans hoped he would continue to shepherd the sprawling Game of Thrones universe after expertly bringing George R.R. Martin's Fire & Blood to life.

Filming for Season 4 is slated to begin in Spring 2027. This timeline is driven by the complex year-long production cycle and the necessity to work around British weather. Condal confirmed his current focus remains solely on the writing. He acknowledged the challenge of crafting the final season while Season 3 is still airing. Matt Smith, Emma D'Arcy, and Olivia Cooke lead the cast in the ongoing struggle for the Iron Throne, set 200 years before the events of Game of Thrones.
excerpt: House of the Dragon showrunner Ryan Condal calls the upcoming fourth and final season "massive," promising the biggest production yet. However, Condal also hinted that he might be ready to exit the Westeros universe after the series concludes, despite a renewed HBO deal.
imageAlt: Ryan Condal, House of the Dragon showrunner, at a press conference
pullQuote: I think I have said what I have to say about Westeros.
editorNote: This is big news for the future of the Game of Thrones universe. Condal's vision has been crucial for House of the Dragon's success. Fans will want to watch closely to see who might helm future Westeros projects if he truly steps away.

title: ¥246 Million Embezzlement Rocks GungHo: Ex-Exec Arrested
content:
A bombshell dropped on July 12: Takanori Kikuchi, former head of systems at gaming giant GungHo Online Entertainment, faces arrest. Tokyo Metropolitan Police allege Kikuchi embezzled a staggering 246 million yen (roughly US$1.57 million) through fictitious business orders. This isn't small change. Kikuchi allegedly routed these payments directly to himself, betraying the trust placed in him.

GungHo is a household name in mobile gaming, primarily known for the enduring phenomenon Puzzle & Dragons. This title alone has generated billions, making GungHo a major player in Japan's entertainment landscape. An alleged internal theft of this magnitude is a significant blow, not just financially but to public and investor confidence. It's a shocking turn for a company synonymous with massive success. The investigation continues, and fans will be watching closely to see how GungHo addresses this serious breach.
excerpt: Former GungHo Online Entertainment head of systems, Takanori Kikuchi, has been arrested for allegedly embezzling a staggering 246 million yen. Police claim Kikuchi created fictitious business orders to pay himself, a major blow to the company known for Puzzle & Dragons.
imageAlt: Police arrest Takanori Kikuchi, former head of systems for GungHo Online Entertainment
pullQuote: Tokyo Metropolitan Police allege Kikuchi embezzled a staggering 246 million yen (roughly US$1.57 million) through fictitious business orders.
editorNote: This arrest casts a shadow over GungHo, reminding us that even major players aren't immune to internal scandals. It's a stark reminder about corporate oversight, especially concerning executive trust. Fans will surely be watching how this impacts GungHo's reputation and operations going forward.

title: Monday the 13th Tease for A24's Crystal Lake Prequel?
content:
A Monday the 13th tease for Peacock's Crystal Lake? That's the cryptic message from showrunner Brad Caleb Kane. He dropped an image on Instagram hinting at something big for the Friday the 13th prequel, featuring "Monday the 13th" text over a machete-wielding figure and a cabin. Fans are buzzing, wondering if new details are imminent for the highly anticipated A24 series.

This isn't just another slasher. Kane has previously called Crystal Lake a "paranoid '70s thriller" with "rivers of blood" and "ingenious kill sequences," but insists it's all in service of character and theme. He's exploring the roots of the original Friday the 13th, tapping into that era's mistrust of institutions and the women's liberation movement. It’s a smart approach, promising a deeper dive into the horror classic.

Linda Cardellini takes on the iconic role of Pamela Voorhees, a character often seen but rarely explored. Kane heaps praise on her performance, stating she'll "shock and surprise a lot of people." Cardellini herself was drawn to the role's untapped potential. Callum Vinson is also set to appear as Jason Voorhees, rounding out a compelling cast. Kane serves as creator, showrunner, writer, and executive producer, steering this ambitious take on the horror legend.
excerpt: Showrunner Brad Caleb Kane dropped a cryptic Instagram tease for Crystal Lake, the upcoming Friday the 13th prequel series. He hinted at new information arriving on "Monday the 13th," sparking fan excitement. The A24 production promises a character-driven, "paranoid '70s thriller" with Linda Cardellini as Pamela Voorhees.
imageAlt: A stylized image featuring a woman holding a machete, standing by a lake with a cabin, text "Monday the 13th"
pullQuote: Linda Cardellini takes on the iconic role of Pamela Voorhees, a character often seen but rarely explored.
editorNote: This could be a significant reinterpretation of horror's most infamous mother, moving beyond simple slasher tropes. Fans will want to watch how Crystal Lake balances its psychological thriller elements with the gore expected from a Friday the 13th story. A24’s involvement signals a strong artistic vision here.

title: Cyborg Faces Dark Choice as Terra's Shocking Demon Origins Revealed in New Titans #37
content:
Hold up, Titans fans. New Titans #37 is dropping a bombshell: Terra, the team's earth-manipulating member, is apparently a "pink-skinned demon protagonist" with ties to an "eternal demon lord Wannabe." That's a massive, unexpected twist for a character often defined by her original betrayal storyline.

But the immediate drama isn't just about her surprising new backstory. Cyborg faces a brutal dilemma. Terra has unearthed his secret workshop. Now, Vic Stone must decide: trust her with his deepest secrets, or bury her for good? This is a significant moment for the hero.

Meanwhile, the rest of the Titans are knee-deep in trouble in Happy Harbor, Rhode Island. A dark force manipulates the quaint New England town. Its citizens are oddly hostile. To top it off, a beast — a dragon, naturally — lurks beneath their new Mountain Headquarters, specifically the Omega Forge.

Writer Tate Brombal and artist Marcus To are bringing the heat in this issue. New Titans #37 hits shelves this Wednesday. Don't miss out.
excerpt: New Titans #37 throws a huge curveball, revealing Terra as a "pink-skinned demon protagonist" connected to an "eternal demon lord Wannabe." This shocking twist puts Cyborg in a tight spot, as he must decide whether to trust Terra with his secrets or "bury her for good" after she discovers his hidden workshop.
imageAlt: Cover art for New Titans #37 featuring Cyborg and Terra
pullQuote: Terra, the team's earth-manipulating member, is apparently a 'pink-skinned demon protagonist' with ties to an 'eternal demon lord Wannabe.'
editorNote: This new take on Terra could redefine her role within the Titans, moving beyond her well-known treacherous past. Fans should definitely keep an eye on how Tate Brombal and Marcus To explore these 'demon' origins. It's a bold move for such an iconic character.

title: Vought Rising Won't Settle Soldier Boy/Stormfront Debate, Teases Timeline Twists for The Boys
content:
The upcoming prequel series, The Boys: Vought Rising, is setting the stage for more questions than answers, and we're here for it. Jensen Ackles, the man behind Soldier Boy, recently dropped a bombshell: the series won't give fans a definitive "yes" or "no" on his character's twisted feelings for Clara Vought, a.k.a. Stormfront. Instead, expect a deep dive into the ambiguous, often disturbing facets of their dynamic. Was it love? Or just another layer of manipulation? Prepare for endless fan debates.

But that's not the only enigma surrounding the 2027 Prime Video release. The Boys showrunner Eric Kripke has been playfully cryptic, hinting that Vought Rising is far more than a simple prequel. Whispers suggest multiple timelines could be in play, potentially even exploring events post-Homelander. Kripke himself alluded to this, stating that Soldier Boy's seemingly abrupt refreezing in the main series will "all make sense" once Vought Rising premieres. This isn't mere backstory; it’s crucial universe-building that promises to reshape our understanding of the entire The Boys saga.

Paul Grellong serves as showrunner, leading a team that includes executive producers Kripke, Seth Rogen, and Evan Goldberg. Ackles and Aya Cash (Stormfront) headline the returning cast, alongside new additions. Get ready to re-examine everything you thought you knew.
excerpt: The Boys: Vought Rising promises to delve into the ambiguous, twisted dynamic between Soldier Boy and Stormfront without a definitive answer. Showrunner Eric Kripke also hints at multi-timeline exploration, suggesting the prequel will be crucial to understanding the wider universe. Get ready for more questions than answers when it hits Prime Video in 2027.
imageAlt: Key art for The Boys: Vought Rising featuring Soldier Boy and Stormfront
pullQuote: This isn't mere backstory; it’s crucial universe-building that promises to reshape our understanding of the entire The Boys saga.
editorNote: The ambiguity surrounding Soldier Boy and Stormfront is classic The Boys, expertly fueling fan theories and debates. What's truly interesting is Kripke's subtle hints about timeline twists, confirming this isn't just a simple prequel but a critical piece of the overarching universe. Fans will want to watch closely for how this reshapes everything.

title: Digger Trailer Drops Amid Buzz: Is Tom Cruise Hiding a Major Transformation?
content:
Tom Cruise playing an old man is the big secret Warner Bros. seems determined to keep under wraps for Digger. Despite a new promo surfacing ahead of tomorrow's trailer debut, marketing continues to obscure Cruise's dramatic transformation in Alejandro G. Iñárritu's upcoming film. CinemaCon attendees first blew the whistle in April, noting how previews carefully avoided showing Cruise's aged portrayal.

Iñárritu, a director celebrated for his visually stunning and character-driven works like Birdman and The Revenant, leads Cruise in what's already billed as the 'role of a lifetime.' While specifics remain vague, the film promises a radical departure for the action star. Fans have speculated for months on why Warner Bros. is so cagey about this unique casting choice.

Tomorrow's full trailer launch might finally reveal Cruise's true look — or perhaps prolong the mystery even further. Digger is slated for an October 2, 2026, release and also stars Jesse Plemons and Sandra Hüller.
excerpt: Tomorrow brings the first full trailer for Alejandro G. Iñárritu's Digger, starring Tom Cruise. However, the film's marketing continues to deliberately hide Cruise's surprising portrayal of an old man, a fact confirmed by early CinemaCon viewers.
imageAlt: Tom Cruise as an aged character from the movie Digger, in a promotional still or poster
pullQuote: Tom Cruise playing an old man is the big secret Warner Bros. seems determined to keep under wraps for Digger.
editorNote: What's interesting here is the deliberate marketing strategy to conceal Cruise's aged appearance. This could be a clever build-up to a shocking reveal, or it might signal Warner Bros.' uncertainty about audience reception to a different kind of Cruise. Fans will want to see if tomorrow's trailer finally pulls back the curtain.

title: SVU Shocker: Ice-T's Fin in Every S28 Episode, Hargitay Directs Landmark 600th
content:
Fans of Law & Order: SVU just got major reassurance for the upcoming 28th season. Beloved series veteran Ice-T confirmed that Detective Odafin "Fin" Tutuola will appear in every single episode. This is big news for a show celebrating its unparalleled longevity, especially after Ice-T had more flexibility for personal projects during Season 27. Production for the new season is officially underway, with an October return on the horizon.

But that's not all the SVU intel surfacing. Mariska Hargitay, the iconic Olivia Benson herself, is stepping behind the camera to direct the landmark 600th episode. It’s a massive milestone for any show, let alone a procedural drama entering its 28th year.

Hargitay also pulled back the curtain on some long-simmering fan frustration. She revealed that both she and co-star Christopher Meloni (Elliot Stabler) disagreed with show creator Dick Wolf's ultimate decision regarding the near-kiss between Benson and Stabler in Season 24. Apparently, alternate takes, where the kiss did happen, were filmed. This insider tidbit confirms what many fans suspected about creative friction surrounding the beloved "Bensler" dynamic. With Law & Order: Organized Crime now canceled, Hargitay cryptically hinted that the door for a Stabler-Benson reunion isn't entirely closed. She even dropped a playful "it's not dun-dun" reference, a tantalizing tease for a relationship that defines the series for many.
excerpt: Law & Order: SVU fans can rejoice as Ice-T confirms Detective Fin Tutuola will be in every episode of Season 28. Star Mariska Hargitay is also set to direct the landmark 600th episode, while revealing her and Christopher Meloni’s disagreement with showrunner Dick Wolf over the Benson-Stabler near-kiss in Season 24.
imageAlt: Promotional image for Law & Order: SVU showing Mariska Hargitay as Olivia Benson and Ice-T as Fin Tutuola
pullQuote: Mariska Hargitay revealed that both she and Christopher Meloni disagreed with Dick Wolf's ultimate decision regarding the Benson and Stabler near-kiss.
editorNote: This is massive for SVU fans! A full season of Fin means consistency, while Hargitay directing the 600th episode is an incredible testament to her influence. What's truly juicy is the behind-the-scenes drama with Wolf over "Bensler" – it confirms a lot of fan theories about their beloved dynamic.

title: Carnage Unleashed: Spider-Versity #4 Brings Campus Killer Horror
content:
Norman Osborn's controversial "training" program for Spider-students just ratcheted up the intensity. Amazing Spider-Man: Spider-Versity #4, hitting shelves this Wednesday, pits our web-slinging heroes against not only their mentor's brutal methods but also a terrifying campus killer. This isn't your average study group.

The Green Goblin-turned-complicated-mentor, Norman Osborn, is pushing the young Spiders to their absolute limits. Miles Morales, Ghost-Spider, and the rest are grappling with grueling real-world exercises and the psychological toll of Osborn's unique brand of tough love. Just when they're picking up the pieces from a particularly harsh session, a new, more sinister threat emerges: Carnage is on campus.

Yes, the red symbiote serial killer is making house calls to dorms. The preview pages hint at a terrifying cat-and-mouse game, with Miles and Ghost-Spider racing across rooftops in a desperate hunt. Even bonding over music with roommate Cindy Moon can't prepare Ghost-Spider for a situation like this. This issue looks less like a training montage and more like a slasher film set in the Spider-Verse, forcing these heroes to confront true horror. Jordan Morris pens the script, with Pere Perez on art, promising a suspenseful ride that challenges both the Spiders' combat skills and their sanity.
excerpt: Amazing Spider-Man: Spider-Versity #4 plunges the young Spiders into a campus nightmare, pitting them against Norman Osborn's brutal training and the terrifying red symbiote, Carnage. This issue promises a high-stakes slasher-film vibe, pushing heroes like Miles Morales and Ghost-Spider to their limits.
imageAlt: Cover for Amazing Spider-Man: Spider-Versity #4 featuring Miles Morales, Ghost-Spider, and other Spiders looking tense.
pullQuote: This issue looks less like a training montage and more like a slasher film set in the Spider-Verse.
editorNote: This pivot to a campus horror theme is a fresh twist for the Spider-Verse, leveraging Norman Osborn's morally ambiguous role perfectly. Fans should expect high tension and perhaps a new look at what 'training' truly means for these young heroes. It's a bold direction we're excited to see unfold.

title: Kirkman's Energon Universe Anime Gets SDCC Hype
content:
Robert Kirkman is gearing up for San Diego Comic-Con, and fans of the Energon Universe should be on high alert. His upcoming "Robert Kirkman Live!" panel promises "exclusive reveals and surprises" for the "expanding vision for Transformers in Skybound and Hasbro's Energon Universe." All signs point to a major update on the highly anticipated adult animated series.

News of the Energon Universe adaptation broke last October. Kirkman's Skybound Entertainment is partnering with Hasbro Entertainment to bring his critically acclaimed comic book series to the screen. Lucifer showrunner Joe Henderson is tapped to pen the adaptation and serve as showrunner, signaling a serious commitment to the project.

The Energon Universe has been a breakout hit since its "stealth launch" in June 2023 with Void Rivals. That series famously concluded with a jaw-dropping appearance from Transformers' Jetfire, instantly connecting the two iconic franchises. Since then, Kirkman has woven together G.I. Joe, Transformers, and even M.A.S.K. into a cohesive, explosive shared world. Kirkman himself expressed wanting "a new way into these series," creating "cohesive entanglements that enrich every series."

This animated adaptation represents a significant step for a universe that has already captivated comic readers. With Kirkman's track record on mature animated hits like Invincible, expectations are sky-high for how he'll translate the action and lore of these beloved characters. Don't miss the panel on Thursday, July 23rd, where we expect more than just hints.
excerpt: Robert Kirkman's upcoming SDCC panel is teasing "exclusive reveals" for the Energon Universe, strongly hinting at an update for the anticipated adult animated series. This adaptation of Kirkman's hit shared comic universe, which unites Transformers, G.I. Joe, and more, is being helmed by Lucifer showrunner Joe Henderson. Fans are eager to see how Kirkman's track record with mature animation will bring this explosive world to life.
imageAlt: Key visual for the Energon Universe featuring Transformers' Optimus Prime, G.I. Joe's Snake Eyes, and characters from Void Rivals.
pullQuote: All signs point to a major update on the highly anticipated adult animated series.
editorNote: This is a big one. Kirkman has a knack for reinventing beloved franchises, and the Energon Universe comics have been a massive success. Fans will want to keep a close eye on this panel; an animated adaptation with his touch could be truly special for Transformers and G.I. Joe alike.

title: Mecha Dream Team: Gundam Wing and Code Geass Collide in New Manga
content:
Mecha fans, prepare for impact! Two absolute titans of the genre, Mobile Suit Gundam Wing and Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion, are finally colliding in a brand-new manga crossover. Titled Shin Kidō Senki Gundam W x Code Geass: Hangyaku no Lelouch: Minuet Zero, this project is nothing short of a dream come true for many.

Veteran artist Tomofumi Ogasawara is drawing the series. Ogasawara-sensei is no stranger to the world of Mobile Suit Gundam Wing, having famously helmed the Mobile Suit Gundam Wing Endless Waltz: Glory of the Losers manga. His deep understanding of the iconic Mobile Suits and characters makes him a perfect fit to blend these universes.

Gundam Wing thrilled 90s audiences with its complex political landscape and stylish mobile suits. Code Geass, a 2000s phenomenon, captivated us with Lelouch's strategic genius and powerful Knightmare Frames. Both series explore themes of rebellion, justice, and the costs of war, making this crossover a genuinely fascinating prospect. This isn't just fan service; it's a convergence of two universes that share deep thematic DNA. Get ready for an epic ride.
excerpt: Two of anime's most iconic mecha sagas, Mobile Suit Gundam Wing and Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion, are finally crossing over in a new manga. Veteran Gundam artist Tomofumi Ogasawara is at the helm, promising an epic blend of political intrigue and unique mecha warfare.
imageAlt: Key visual for the Shin Kidō Senki Gundam W x Code Geass: Hangyaku no Lelouch: Minuet Zero crossover manga
entities: Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion
pullQuote: Two absolute titans of the genre, Mobile Suit Gundam Wing and Code Geass, are finally colliding in a brand-new manga.
editorNote: This crossover is huge news for longtime mecha fans. It’s a rare chance to see how two distinct yet thematically similar universes can intertwine. We'll be watching closely to see how Ogasawara-sensei balances the iconic elements of both series.

title: Weatherly's NCIS Return: Tony & Ziva Spinoff Stays Canon
content:
Tony DiNozzo is back, and his return to NCIS is more canon-compliant than fans might expect. Michael Weatherly revealed this weekend that his upcoming season-long arc on NCIS Season 24 won't retcon the events of the NCIS: Tony & Ziva spinoff. This is a significant relief for viewers who worried about the fate of the beloved couple's shared history.

Weatherly, who starts filming July 14th, confirmed the continuity at Comic Con Midlands alongside Cote de Pablo, his Ziva David co-star. The "Tony & Ziva" spinoff, which explored their life after NCIS, wrapped up its first season without a renewal. While de Pablo's on-screen return to NCIS remains unconfirmed, Weatherly’s comments strongly suggest their storyline will be respected.

He emphasized that "Tony & Ziva" remains canon. The actor expressed respect for the current NCIS iteration, acknowledging it's evolved since his original departure after Season 13. Weatherly believes his character can seamlessly integrate, bringing back the "formula of the original show" with its crime, investigation, and character interplay. It’s a delicate balance, but one fans have eagerly awaited.
excerpt: Michael Weatherly confirmed his return to NCIS Season 24 won't retcon the NCIS: Tony & Ziva spinoff, preserving the fan-favorite couple's history. Filming starts July 14th for his season-long arc, with Weatherly emphasizing respect for the show's current direction. Fans can breathe a sigh of relief as Tony DiNozzo's story continues, fully intact.
imageAlt: Michael Weatherly and Cote de Pablo smiling at a Comic Con event
pullQuote: His upcoming season-long arc on NCIS Season 24 won't retcon the events of the NCIS: Tony & Ziva spinoff.
editorNote: This is fantastic news for fans of Tony and Ziva, whose journey felt unfinished after the spinoff's cancellation. It shows the NCIS team understands the importance of character continuity. We're curious to see how Ziva's story will be acknowledged if Cote de Pablo doesn't make an on-screen appearance.

title: Activision’s Black Ops PS5 Rerelease Stirs Fan Fury Over Steep Pricing
content:
Activision just pulled a move that's got gamers fuming. Call of Duty: Black Ops and Black Ops II, iconic entries from 2010 and 2012, suddenly dropped on PS5 this week. It was a surprise release, with independent studio Iron Galaxy handling the port. But the excitement quickly turned to outrage.

Fans recall a time when these two games came bundled for just $30. Now, Activision asks $40 for each title, forcing players to shell out $80 for the pair. This blatant price hike has sparked widespread criticism, slamming the publisher for a clear cash grab. Nostalgia might be powerful, but not everyone's willing to empty their wallets for it.
excerpt: Activision surprised gamers by dropping Call of Duty: Black Ops and Black Ops II on PS5 this week. But the nostalgia quickly soured as fans discovered the two games now cost $80, a significant jump from their original $30 bundle price, sparking outrage over a perceived cash grab.
imageAlt: Key art for the Call of Duty Black Ops video game showing a soldier in tactical gear
pullQuote: Fans recall a time when these two games came bundled for just $30. Now, Activision asks $40 for each title, forcing players to shell out $80 for the pair.
editorNote: This move by Activision highlights a concerning trend where publishers leverage nostalgia for older titles with questionable pricing strategies. It's a reminder for fans to always weigh the value against the hype. Hopefully, this backlash sends a message that players expect fair treatment, even for beloved classics.

title: First-Ever Vinyl for Iconic 1995 Ghost in the Shell Film Score, Plus SAC and PS1 Game Soundtracks Land
content:
Fans have waited decades for this: Kenji Kawai's iconic score for Mamoru Oshii's 1995 Ghost in the Shell film gets its first-ever official vinyl pressing. We Release Whatever The Fuck We Want Records meticulously cut the audio from original master reels at Emil Berliner Studios. Kawai's haunting compositions famously blend ancient Japanese harmonies and percussions with futuristic synthesizers. The legendary "Making of Cyborg" theme, chanted by a choir in ancient Japanese with Bulgarian folk harmonies, defined the film's profound reflections on humanity and technology. This is an essential piece of anime history, finally preserved for audiophiles.

Meanwhile, Black Screen Records delivers five distinct vinyl releases for Ghost in the Shell: Stand Alone Complex. Yoko Kanno's acclaimed music for the Production I.G series, directed by Kenji Kamiyama, is legendary. Her unique fusion of digital electronica, Eastern European folk, jazz, and rock, featuring multilingual vocals, perfectly captured the cyberpunk future. These soundtracks have long been fan favorites, now accessible in a new format.

Not to be outdone, iam8bit drops the "mythical" Ghost in the Shell Megatech Body 2xLP, the soundtrack from the 1997 PlayStation game. This isn't just a game score; it's a cult classic of pulse-pounding techno. Legendary figures like Derrick May, Hardfloor, and Westbam contributed, expertly compiled by Takkyu Ishino. The album even boasts stunning Yamato-e illustrations from renowned artist Takashi Murakami. It’s a deep cut for serious collectors.
excerpt: The legendary 1995 Ghost in the Shell film score is finally getting its first-ever official vinyl pressing, meticulously remastered from original master reels. Fans can also grab multiple albums from the acclaimed Stand Alone Complex anime and the 'mythical' 1997 PlayStation game soundtrack, featuring techno legends and Takashi Murakami's art.
imageAlt: Collection of Ghost in the Shell vinyl soundtracks, including the 1995 film, Stand Alone Complex, and PlayStation game covers
pullQuote: The 1995 Ghost in the Shell film score is finally receiving its first-ever official vinyl pressing, meticulously remastered from original master reels.
editorNote: This is huge for audiophiles and long-time fans. These soundtracks aren't just background noise; they're essential parts of the GITS legacy. What's interesting is seeing the care put into preserving these iconic scores, from original master reels to legendary techno collaborations.

title: RDJ's Doctor Doom & X-Men Join Avengers: Doomsday in First Major Marketing Push
content:
Marvel's long-awaited marketing push for Avengers: Doomsday has finally arrived, and it's dropping bombshells. New promo art and an international teaser confirm Robert Downey Jr.'s return, not as Iron Man, but as the iconic villain Doctor Doom. This alone is a monumental reveal, signaling Marvel's biggest gamble and potential course correction yet.

The new visuals also highlight a colossal cast, surprisingly integrating beloved X-Men characters like Patrick Stewart’s Professor X and Ian McKellen’s Magneto alongside returning MCU heroes. It’s clear Marvel Studios is going for broke, bringing back the Russo brothers – directors of Endgame – a move seen as a safe bet after a bumpy post-Thanos era.

The studio had kept details under wraps for ages, leaving fans speculating. Now, this sudden surge of promotion, following the earlier confirmation of production, points to an all-in strategy. Avengers: Doomsday hits theaters on December 18, 2026. Get ready.
excerpt: After a long silence, Marvel's Avengers: Doomsday finally launches its marketing. New promo art and an international teaser confirm Robert Downey Jr.'s return as Doctor Doom, alongside a colossal cast integrating fan-favorite X-Men characters. This signals Marvel's potential shift towards familiar faces and proven talent.
imageAlt: Promotional art for Avengers: Doomsday featuring Robert Downey Jr. as Doctor Doom surrounded by other Marvel heroes and X-Men characters.
pullQuote: Robert Downey Jr. is confirmed back as Doctor Doom, leading a cast that surprisingly integrates iconic X-Men characters.
editorNote: This is a massive shift for the MCU, clearly aiming to recapture past glory and fan excitement. Bringing back RDJ, even as Doom, and integrating X-Men so explicitly means they're not messing around. Fans should watch for how this affects the overall narrative and future crossover potential.

title: Lobo #5: The Main Man's 'Victory Lap' Hits a Snag
content:
The Main Man is back, but his "cosmic glory" tour isn't quite shining. Lobo #5 drops soon, throwing DC's notorious bounty hunter into a new era of chaos — officially "recertified" but already running from the consequences.

Lobo, the galaxy's baddest bounty hunter, supposedly emerged victorious from a brawl with Supergirl. We assume she's retired now, because that's Lobo's story, and he's sticking to it. Now, with loyal Dawg in tow, he's ditching Earth before anyone can verify his claims or question his recent professional license. Classic Lobo arrogance.

But even the Main Man has PR problems. Our favorite Czarnian is drowning in hate mail, and his own agent has put a bounty on his head. It seems his unique brand of "victory" comes with a hefty price tag. He's also looking to get in "even better shape," which likely means more gratuitous violence and collateral damage are on the horizon. The preview pages hint at a wild encounter with a character named Lip Bomb at a joint called "Chug N' Slug." Expect fireworks, and probably a few broken bones.

Writer Skottie Young and artist Jorge Corona are steering this chaotic ship. This duo is a fitting choice for Lobo's blend of over-the-top action and dark humor. Young is known for his distinctive cartoonish style and irreverent storytelling, while Corona's dynamic art promises to make Lobo's signature mayhem pop off the page.

Lobo #5 arrives on July 15th, 2026. Get ready for more irreverent antics from DC's most outlandish anti-hero.
excerpt: DC's infamous bounty hunter Lobo is "recertified" but immediately facing the fallout of his dubious "victory" against Supergirl. Lobo #5 sees him dealing with hate mail and a bounty from his own agent, all while looking for new trouble with writer Skottie Young and artist Jorge Corona at the helm.
imageAlt: Cover art for Lobo #5 featuring Lobo, a large gray alien with red eyes and a chain, with his dog Dawg.
pullQuote: Even the Main Man has PR problems: Our favorite Czarnian is drowning in hate mail, and his own agent has put a bounty on his head.
editorNote: Lobo is always a wild ride, and this sounds like a classic Main Man scenario: talk big, cause trouble, and then deal with the hilarious aftermath. Skottie Young and Jorge Corona are a dream team for this character, promising both visual flair and razor-sharp wit. Fans should buckle up.

title: Soulframe Unleashes Dark Gameplay, Warframe Invades Fortnite at TennoCon 2026
content:
TennoCon 2026 dropped major news for Digital Extremes' titles, but it was the long-awaited Soulframe gameplay demo that truly stole the show. The fantasy action RPG, a spiritual successor to Warframe, finally showed off its evolving world, teasing a "corrupted player progression path" that sounds deliciously dark. Fans also cheered for the debut of a fishing mini-game and, perhaps most anticipated, a full mount system. Voice acting heavyweights Ben Starr (Final Fantasy XVI) and Jennifer English (Clair Obscur: Expedition 33) were also confirmed, adding serious talent to the cast.

Warframe wasn't left behind. The surreal sci-fi universe is breaking new ground with a major Fortnite crossover, bringing an exclusive Excalibur skin for players who purchase eligible items on the Epic Games Store. Even the in-game boyband On-lyne, from the upcoming Warframe: 1999, made waves with their track "Party Of Your Lifetime" hitting Fortnite Festival.

Looking ahead, the Fall update "Iceblade of Narin" promises the 66th Warframe, an ice-themed female warrior, plus a Banshee rework and deluxe skin for Qorvex. Citrine Prime, a stunning Orokin-era Prime Warframe, also makes her grand debut. Digital Extremes continues its global tour, promising more details in a September Devstream from Seoul. It's a busy year for Tenno, old and new.
excerpt: Digital Extremes showcased a long-awaited Soulframe gameplay demo at TennoCon 2026, revealing a "corrupted player progression path," mount system, and fishing mini-game. Meanwhile, Warframe players can jump into Fortnite with an exclusive Excalibur skin, as the sci-fi universe crosses over with Epic Games' battle royale.
imageAlt: Screenshot of Soulframe gameplay showing a character on a mount, with fantasy landscape in the background.
pullQuote: The fantasy action RPG finally showed off its evolving world, teasing a "corrupted player progression path" that sounds deliciously dark.
editorNote: This TennoCon delivered big for both new and veteran players. The Soulframe demo's dark progression path and the confirmed voice cast set a promising tone for DE's next major IP. But the Warframe x Fortnite crossover is massive — expect a huge influx of new players and plenty of memes.

title: Doctor Who Fans Get Massive Drop of Tenth Doctor/Rose Deleted Scenes
content:
The BBC just unleashed a vault of previously unseen deleted scenes from Doctor Who's beloved Series 2. Fans are buzzing, and for good reason: these clips offer fresh perspectives on the iconic Tenth Doctor, played by David Tennant, and his beloved companion Rose Tyler, portrayed by Billie Piper.

This unexpected drop follows the recent 20th anniversary of the Series 2 finale, "Doomsday," a two-part epic infamous for its gut-wrenching farewell between the Doctor and Rose. While an initial release focused on that pivotal goodbye, this new wave expands across multiple Series 2 episodes, including "The Christmas Invasion" and "The Girl in the Fireplace." It’s a rare treat, delving deeper into a period many consider a golden age for the modern revival.

Tennant himself recently reflected on his lifelong obsession with Doctor Who, calling his casting an "impossible opportunity" that profoundly changed his life. This release only cements the enduring legacy of his era and the powerful bond shared by the Tenth Doctor and Rose.
excerpt: The BBC surprised Doctor Who fans with a trove of previously unreleased deleted scenes from Series 2, spotlighting the iconic Tenth Doctor and Rose Tyler. This follows the 20th anniversary of the heartbreaking "Doomsday" finale, deepening the look into one of the show's most beloved eras.
imageAlt: The Tenth Doctor and Rose Tyler looking at each other, in a scene from Doctor Who Series 2
pullQuote: The BBC just unleashed a vault of previously unseen deleted scenes from Doctor Who's beloved Series 2.
editorNote: This is a fantastic surprise for Whovians, especially those who grew up with Tennant and Piper. It's rare for such a significant volume of old footage to surface, highlighting the lasting impact these characters still have. Could this signal more archival releases from the classic era?

title: Star Wars Droid Army Builder Pack Drops, Sells Out Instantly
content:
Star Wars collectors, ready your wallets! Hasbro just dropped a Separatist Droid Army Builder four-pack for The Vintage Collection, and it's already a hot commodity. This essential release features three Geonosis B1 Battle Droids and a Super Battle Droid, each highly detailed with weapons and blast effects.

This set perfectly complements Hasbro's Republic Gunship HasLab project, letting fans recreate the pivotal Battle of Geonosis from Star Wars: Attack of the Clones. It’s a prime example of how collector lines, much like those in anime, thrive on detailed army-building for iconic scene recreation. Priced at $67.99, this premium set sold out quickly on Hasbro. Watch for restocks at shopDisney – these droids won't stay put.
excerpt: Hasbro's new Separatist Droid Army Builder four-pack for The Vintage Collection sold out moments after release, proving its immediate collector appeal. This highly detailed set, featuring Geonosis Battle Droids and a Super Battle Droid, is designed to enhance displays and complement the Republic Gunship HasLab project.
imageAlt: The Star Wars The Vintage Collection Separatist Droid Army Builder 4-pack, showing three B1 Battle Droids and one Super Battle Droid in packaging.
pullQuote: It’s a prime example of how collector lines, much like those in anime, thrive on detailed army-building for iconic scene recreation.
editorNote: This release shows the enduring appeal of army-building sets in collector culture, a trend we see across everything from Star Wars to popular anime figure lines like Figma. Fans should definitely keep an eye on restocks, as these sought-after droids are a must-have for any serious Clone Wars display.

title: Ao no Hako Ends Five-Year Run in Weekly Shonen Jump
content: Kouji Miura's popular sports romance, Ao no Hako (Blue Box), concluded its five-year serialization in Weekly Shonen Jump with its 250th and final chapter this week. Shueisha plans the 28th and final volume for December. This marks a bittersweet farewell for fans of the beloved series.
excerpt: Kouji Miura's popular sports romance manga Ao no Hako (Blue Box) has officially concluded its five-year serialization in Weekly Shonen Jump. The series, known for its blend of high school sports and heartfelt romance, delivered its 250th and final chapter this week.
imageAlt: Cover of the final Ao no Hako manga volume featuring its main characters Taiki Inomata and Chinatsu Kano.
pullQuote: This marks a bittersweet farewell for fans of the beloved series.
editorNote: The end of Ao no Hako leaves a significant sports romance void in Weekly Shonen Jump. Fans will be eager to see what Kouji Miura tackles next, and which new series will step up to fill the gap. Perhaps it's a good time to revisit the early volumes for that nostalgic first love feeling.

title: Razer Goes Kawaii: Pompompurin Leads Target-Exclusive Sanrio Drop
content:
Razer just dropped a surprise: a new Sanrio collection, and it's a Target exclusive. Fans are already buzzing over the star of the show – a full Pompompurin lineup. We're talking keyboard, mouse, and mousepad, all decked out in those signature buttercup hues. It's pure golden retriever energy mixed with Razer's reliable performance.

But the cuteness doesn't stop there. Razer also rolled out a sleek, rose gold Hello Kitty mouse, adding a touch of metallic glam to any setup. title: Portlandia Creators Armisen, Brownstein Reunite for Rewatch Podcast
content:
Eight years after Portlandia concluded its run, creators Fred Armisen and Carrie Brownstein are finally back together. The iconic duo will revisit their beloved sketch comedy series on a new podcast: Podlandia: A-O Rewatch, launching July 16th.

Portlandia, which aired for 77 episodes across eight seasons on IFC, carved a unique niche in pop culture. It expertly lampooned the specific, often absurd, subcultures of its namesake city. Fans have long missed Armisen and Brownstein's distinct comedic chemistry and incisive observational humor. Now, they'll unpack the show's legacy, episode by episode.

The weekly podcast, a production from iHeartRadio and Will Ferrell's Big Money Players, promises exclusive behind-the-scenes stories. Expect to hear from a roster of familiar faces, including Mayor Kyle MacLachlan and co-creator Jonathan Krisel. Brownstein noted her hope to continue the conversations about community and absurdity the show started. Armisen expressed genuine laughter rewatching the episodes, finding it illuminating and a joy to reminisce with Brownstein. This is a significant event for anyone who cherished Portlandia's singular world.
excerpt: Fred Armisen and Carrie Brownstein are finally reuniting for Podlandia: A-O Rewatch, a new podcast revisiting their cult-classic sketch comedy series. Launching July 16th, the duo promises deep dives into Portlandia's unique world with special guests like Kyle MacLachlan.
imageAlt: Fred Armisen and Carrie Brownstein smiling together, with a microphone on a stand in front of them
pullQuote: Revisiting these episodes reminded me of the ways Fred is singularly hilarious.
editorNote: It's always a treat when creators revisit their beloved work, especially after years. Fans of Portlandia's distinct brand of absurdism finally get an official reunion. This could set a new standard for creator-led rewatch podcasts, offering insights only the original minds can provide.

title: VFX Legends Ishiro Honda, Tomoyuki Tanaka Inducted Into VES Hall of Fame
content:
Two titans of Japanese cinema, Ishiro Honda and Tomoyuki Tanaka, are finally receiving long-overdue recognition from the Visual Effects Society. The VES will induct the legendary director and producer, architects of the iconic Godzilla franchise, into its esteemed Hall of Fame. This is a monumental moment, acknowledging their foundational work that shaped not just Japanese cinema, but the entire landscape of visual storytelling.

Honda, the visionary director, and Tanaka, the prolific producer, spearheaded Toho's golden age of kaiju films. Their collaboration on the original 1954 Godzilla pioneered tokusatsu, a form of practical special effects that became synonymous with Japanese monster movies. Forget green screens; Honda and Tanaka mastered miniature sets, suitmation, and forced perspective, creating a believable destructive force that captivated audiences worldwide. Their techniques influenced countless filmmakers and continue to inspire modern VFX artists.

The Visual Effects Society, the industry's premier global professional organization, is celebrating its 25th anniversary with these inductions. Their Honors Celebration will take place on September 4 at the Skirball Cultural Center in Los Angeles. It’s fitting that as the Godzilla franchise continues its global box office dominance, the original masterminds are finally getting their flowers from Hollywood. This isn't just an award; it's a testament to the enduring power and global reach of Japanese imagination and technical ingenuity.
excerpt: Two titans of Japanese cinema, Ishiro Honda and Tomoyuki Tanaka, architects of the iconic Godzilla franchise, are finally receiving long-overdue recognition from the Visual Effects Society. The VES will induct the pioneering director and producer into its esteemed Hall of Fame this September, honoring their foundational work that reshaped visual effects globally.
imageAlt: Portrait images of director Ishiro Honda and producer Tomoyuki Tanaka, creators of Godzilla, next to the Visual Effects Society logo.
pullQuote: This is global recognition for foundational work that shaped not just Japanese cinema, but the entire landscape of visual storytelling.
editorNote: This induction solidifies the global impact of Japanese tokusatsu and pioneers like Honda and Tanaka. Fans should revisit their classic works to truly appreciate the groundbreaking effects that influenced generations of filmmakers. What's interesting is how long it took Hollywood to officially acknowledge this monumental contribution.

title: Godzilla Architects Honored: Honda and Tanaka Enter VFX Hall of Fame
content:
Legendary Godzilla director Ishirō Honda and producer Tomoyuki Tanaka are finally getting their due. The Visual Effects Society (VES) announced their posthumous induction into its prestigious Hall of Fame. This is a monumental nod to the duo whose groundbreaking work birthed the king of kaiju and shaped an entire genre.

Honda, the visionary director of the original 1954 Godzilla, pioneered the iconic suitmation technique. He masterfully blended actors in monster suits with intricate miniatures, crafting large-scale destruction that captivated audiences worldwide. Tanaka, the driving force at Toho Studios, conceived the very idea of Godzilla. He nurtured the franchise from its inception, overseeing its artistic and commercial journey for decades. Together with special effects director Eiji Tsuburaya, they forged a cinematic legacy.

This induction isn't just about two men; it's a profound recognition of Japanese tokusatsu's global impact. Godzilla's practical effects, distinct from Western methods, set new standards and influenced countless filmmakers. For years, fans of classic sci-fi and special effects have championed their innovation. The VES Hall of Fame, a body that celebrates significant achievements in visual effects, now formally acknowledges the artistry and lasting influence of these kaiju pioneers. The official celebration takes place in Los Angeles on September 4.

title: Don Callis Family Claims Triple Gold, Hangman Page Pivots on AEW Collision
content:
Hangman Adam Page's emotional return to AEW Collision wasn't just a comeback; it was a character reset that promises a fresh direction for a fan-favorite. After a four-month absence following a crushing loss, the "Anxious Millennial Cowboy" confirmed he’d honor his stipulation and never challenge for the AEW Men's World Championship again. This bold declaration set the stage for a new chapter. Page has now set his sights on the TNT, National, Continental, and International titles, a strategic pivot signaling a major shift in his career trajectory.

Championship action dominated the night. ROH World Champion Bandido put on a clinic, defeating Katsuyori Shibata and ending Shibata’s impressive 19-match winning streak in a hard-fought technical battle. TBS Champion Hikaru Shida also retained her title against Harley Cameron. The real post-match shocker came when Shida continued her attack, only for Queen Aminata to rush the ring for the save – a clear setup for a compelling new dynamic in AEW’s ever-evolving women's division.

The Don Callis Family continued its iron grip on AEW, demonstrating their collective power. Kyle Fletcher, officially the new AEW International Champion after vacating the title due to injury, stood alongside Mark Davis, Brian Cage, Trent Beretta, and Jake Doyle. This formidable faction now boasts control of three championships across Collision, including the AEW National and Continental titles, consolidating their undeniable influence.

Willow Nightingale delivered a powerful, emotional promo, chronicling her journey back from injury and her recent Casino Gauntlet win. She passionately declared her challenge for Thekla's AEW Women's World Championship at Redemption, with an even bigger target: Mercedes Moné at All In Wembley. This is a massive declaration of intent, setting up what could be one of the biggest women's storylines of the year. Willow quickly built on this, proposing a six-woman tag match for next week's Dynamite.

Meanwhile, the Death Riders, featuring AEW Continental Champion Jon Moxley, Claudio Castagnoli, Wheeler Yuta, and Daniel Garcia, showcased their brutal efficiency. They dismantled their opponents with ease, prompting Moxley's chilling post-match declaration of "Death Riders against the world."

The main event saw the AEW National Championship defended, with Mark Davis, backed by the Don Callis Family, facing Mike Bailey. Despite Bailey’s previous win over Davis and strong fan support, Jake Doyle’s ringside interference proved decisive. Davis capitalized, retaining his title and solidifying the Don Callis Family's night. As Collision went off the air, the faction stood tall, celebrating their continued, undeniable control and leaving fans questioning who can possibly stop their momentum.
excerpt: Hangman Adam Page made an emotional return to AEW Collision, dramatically shifting his championship focus away from the AEW Men's World Title to target other major singles championships. Meanwhile, the dominant Don Callis Family solidified their power, celebrating control over three major titles by night's end. The show also saw significant developments in the women's division and continued faction warfare.

pullQuote: Hangman Adam Page's emotional return to AEW Collision wasn't just a comeback; it was a character reset.
editorNote: Hangman's pivot is a huge deal for AEW's long-term storytelling; it keeps him relevant without constantly chasing the top belt. The Don Callis Family's grip on multiple championships makes them a legitimate threat across the board, setting up exciting future challengers. Fans should keep an eye on Willow Nightingale's trajectory, as her declared goals could define the women's division for months.

title: Darkroom Delivers Cult Classics: Crusher Joe and Simoun Lead Niche Anime Push
content:
Darkroom is making a strategic play for veteran anime fans. The niche streaming service just dropped a surprise lineup of cult classics, notably the 80s sci-fi staple Crusher Joe and the mid-2000s yuri mecha series Simoun. This isn't your average seasonal simulcast dump; Darkroom is clearly staking its claim as the go-to service for deeply treasured, often-overlooked anime gems.

Crusher Joe, with its iconic character designs from Yoshikazu Yasuhiko (Mobile Suit Gundam), is a quintessential space opera. Fans can now stream the original 1983 movie and the two OVAs, "A Trap of the Frozen Jail" and "The Final Weapon ASH." It's a landmark series known for its adventurous spirit and solid world-building. Meanwhile, Simoun (2006) offers a completely different, yet equally compelling, experience. This series explores identity, spirituality, and conflict within a unique all-female society that pilots sentient flying mecha. It’s a standout for its thoughtful narrative and prominent yuri themes.

This move by Darkroom is significant. While other platforms chase the latest shonen hits, Darkroom seems to be curating a library aimed at specific, dedicated fandoms. It's a smart strategy to differentiate itself in an increasingly crowded streaming landscape.
excerpt: Niche streaming service Darkroom is making waves by adding beloved cult classics Crusher Joe and Simoun to its library. This strategic move suggests a focus on veteran anime fans and overlooked gems rather than just mainstream hits, carving out a unique space in the crowded streaming landscape.

pullQuote: Darkroom is clearly staking its claim as the go-to service for deeply treasured, often-overlooked anime gems.
editorNote: This is an exciting development for fans who've been longing for easier access to these foundational titles. We'll be watching closely to see what other deep cuts Darkroom unearths next. It could signal a new trend in anime streaming.

title: Strange New Worlds to 'Rethink' Kirk's Fatherhood Narrative in Upcoming Season
content:
Get ready, Star Trek fans: Strange New Worlds is boldly going where few prequels have dared. Executive Producer Henry Alonso Myers confirms the upcoming Season 4 will delve deep into Captain Kirk's relationship with his son, David Marcus, an iconic but tragic story first explored in Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan.

But this isn't just a simple revisit. Myers explicitly calls it a "rethink" of the narrative. The show aims to explore Kirk's role as a father without painting him as "lousy," a challenge given David's established backstory where he grew up largely estranged from his famous dad. This provides a unique opportunity to humanize a legendary figure, filling in emotional gaps that the original series and films couldn't fully address.

David Marcus, son of Kirk and Carol Marcus, was a crucial, albeit short-lived, character introduced in the fan-favorite Wrath of Khan. His tragic death in The Search for Spock cemented his place in Star Trek lore, leaving Kirk with profound personal grief. Strange New Worlds, known for its character-driven approach and deep respect for original canon, is uniquely positioned to explore these untold facets.

Myers highlights the joy of doing a prequel: "You get to live in the moment, knowing the future, showing things that they probably hadn't planned to do back in the day." This approach allows the series to contextualize established events, adding layers to characters we thought we knew. It's a bold move that promises to enrich one of Star Trek's most poignant personal stories.
excerpt: Strange New Worlds Season 4 will "rethink" Captain Kirk's relationship with his son, David Marcus, a narrative central to Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan. Executive Producer Henry Alonso Myers aims to explore Kirk's fatherhood without portraying him negatively, leveraging the prequel format to add new emotional depth to a classic story.
imageAlt: Key art for Star Trek Strange New Worlds featuring James T. Kirk (Paul Wesley) in a Starfleet uniform
pullQuote: Myers wants to explore Kirk as a father without portraying him as "lousy."
editorNote: This is a significant shift in how we understand one of Star Trek's most iconic characters. Fans will want to watch how Strange New Worlds navigates this delicate balance, adding new layers to Kirk's personal history without contradicting established canon. What's interesting here is the show's commitment to using the prequel format to enrich, rather than simply retell, classic stories.
